title: Decoding value bounded by optimum
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q>0$, let $T$ be a long-code table, and let $\varepsilon$ be real. For any default label in $\{0,\ldots,q-1\}$, the decoding value formed from the notable-coordinate candidate sets is at most the optimum value of the finite unique-game constraint instance associated with $G$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with alphabet size q > 0
A default label in Fin q
